# Recreation Prompt

Build **Chrome Capsule Defense**, a portrait-first mobile browser tower defense strategy game. Preserve a 6x10 turn-based grid, card-based defender deployment, energy costs, bottom-three-row deployment, friendly unit movement and attacks, enemy waves, boss breach HP, core HP, win/loss overlays, credits, and wave progression. Reinterpret the loop as a satirical neon anime chrome city defense where a friend squad protects a Chrome Capsule core from tryhard psychic breach mobs. Use browser-native Canvas, CSS, and DOM, with an animated Neo-Tokyo road background, chrome HUD panels, neon cyan/pink/yellow palette, large one-thumb CTAs, and short readable instructions. The result should look like an authored public-facing tower defense game, not a generic reskin.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The preserved source is a single-page portrait canvas tower-defense tactics game. It uses a 6 by 10 grid, card-based defender deployment, energy, a player turn and enemy turn, mobile pointer input, boss HP, player core HP, level escalation, credits, a loadout lobby, and win/loss overlays.

## Protected mechanics
- 6 column by 10 row grid.
- Cards selected from a bottom rack and deployed only in the bottom three rows when affordable.
- Energy starts at 5 for a level, replenishes up to a max of 10 each player turn, and is consumed by cards/spells.
- Friendly units can be selected, moved within movement range, and attack enemies within attack range once per turn.
- Enemies advance/attack during enemy phase; boss pressure damages the core.
- Boss/breach HP and player/core HP drive win/loss.
- Credits and level progress are awarded on victory and feed the lobby/loadout loop.

## Transformable surfaces
HUD language, onboarding, card names/icons, unit silhouettes, canvas rendering, particles, background, palette, overlays, typography, and feedback tone are safe presentation surfaces.

## Remixed target
Chrome Capsule Defense is a satirical neon anime tower defense about friends defending a chrome capsule-bike bastion from tryhard psychic breach mobs. The gameplay remains source-truthful while the public surface becomes a bespoke mobile-first Neo-Tokyo defense scene.
